ops.text: The Company may assign this Agreement without HDI's consent to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets. HDI may not assign this Agreement without the prior written consent of the Company, which consent shall not be unreasonably withheld, and may not assign this Agreement to a competitor of the Company. HDI shall have no right to terminate this Agreement upon a change of control of the Company.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 10.3 sets no consent standard, so HDI could assign this hosting arrangement to anyone, including a competitor of ours. We have added one sentence-set leaving 10.3 untouched: we may assign to an affiliate or M&A successor without consent, HDI needs our consent (not unreasonably withheld) and cannot assign to our competitors, and HDI gets no termination right on our change of control.
proposal.summary: Insert preferred assignment consent standard after Section 10.3: Company free to assign to affiliates/successors, HDI needs our consent and cannot assign to a competitor, no HDI termination on our change of control.
